compute_pascal_triangle_sum: compute the sum of all elements up to the nth row in Pascal's Triangle using f_gold
run_f_gold: run f_gold with an integer n to get 2^n minus 1 as the Pascal triangle sum
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which calculates Pascal's Triangle cumulative sum via bit shifting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the bit shift approach with an explicit power function
